# function: json_format

Formats / beautifies a given JSON string

## Signature

```text
json_format(json string, indent ...number) string
```

## Arguments

1. `json` (String) A JSON string to format / beautify
2. `indent` (Number, Optional) The number of spaces to use for each indent. Defaults to 2 if not provided.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Using default indent (2 spaces)
output "formatted_json_default" {
  value = provider::tfutils::json_format("{\"name\":\"test\",\"value\":123}")
}

# Using custom indent (4 spaces)
output "formatted_json_custom" {
  value = provider::tfutils::json_format("{\"name\":\"test\",\"value\":123}", 4)
}
```
